No. 2082/8 – TUESDAY, JULY, 31, 2018
EXTRAORDINARY
REGISTRATION OF ELECTORS ACT, No. 44 of 1980

IN the exercise of the powers vested by Section 8(1) of the Registration of Electors Act, No. 44 of 1980, the Election Commission does hereby appoint for the Electoral Districts specified in Column 1 of the Schedule hereto, the Assistant Registering Officers mentioned in the corresponding entry in Column II respectively. MAHINDA DESHAPRIYA, N. J. ABEYSEKERE, S. RATNAJEEVAN H. HOOLE Chairman Member Member Election Commission. Election Commission. Election Commission. Elections Secretariat, Sarana Mawatha, Rajagiriya. 31st July 2018.
G 27785 - 47 (2018/07) This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
